title: Associativity of constant-to-completed scalar balancing
statement: Let l be prime and let E, F and L be finite extensions of Q_l, with Q_l-algebra embeddings i:E -> F and j:F -> L, allowing identity embeddings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let W be any scheme and let K be any object of the unbounded derived category of completed integral E-module sheaves on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write U_H for exact restriction to the constant integral H-coefficients, B_ji for exact derived constant scalar extension, C_ji for ordinary completed derived scalar extension, and chi_ji: B_ji U_i -> U_j C_ji for the comparison normalized on all complex counits in [lem-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-reduction]. Let alpha_B be the exact localization of the ordinary associator fixed by the composite scalar adjunction and restriction compositor; let alpha_C be tensorComposition, the left-adjoint-uniqueness associator for the completed scalar adjunctions, using the actual equality of the composite completed coefficient maps. Then, in diagrammatic order, B_21(chi_10,K) followed by chi_21,C_10 K followed by U_2(alpha_C,K) equals alpha_B,U_0 K followed by chi_20,K. This includes arbitrary unbounded K, zero objects, identity embeddings and empty schemes; no compact-support or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply ordinary balancing associativity. Exactness of completed tensor extension follows from the ordinary balancing after forgetting to abelian sheaves. Identify each specified derived balancing with exact localization using its all-complex counit normalization. Exact-derived square pasting localizes the ordinary associativity square. Transport this square along the counit-normalized completedTensorModel comparisons and their associator compatibility; cancel the final model isomorphism. This proves the stated equality for arbitrary unbounded K.

theorem scalarCompletion_composition
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (j : F →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)) :
    (baseTensor l F L j W).map ((scalarCompletion l E F i W).hom.app K) ≫
        (scalarCompletion l F L j W).hom.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).obj K) ≫
        (scalarConstantRestriction l L W).map
          ((PurCompactSupport.tensorComposition _ _ _
            (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E F i L j W)).hom.app K) =
      (letI := (baseTensor_exact l E F i W).1
       letI := (baseTensor_exact l E F i W).2
       letI := (baseTensor_exact l F L j W).1
       letI := (baseTensor_exact l F L j W).2
       letI := (baseTensor_exact l E L (j.comp i) W).1
       letI := (baseTensor_exact l E L (j.comp i) W).2
       ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
          ((((pbcScalarAdjunction (constantMap l E F i W)).comp
            (pbcScalarAdjunction (constantMap l F L j W))).ofNatIsoRight
              (pbcRestrictComp _ _ _ (by
                unfold constantMap
                rw [← Functor.map_comp]
                congr 1))).leftAdjointUniq
                  (pbcScalarAdjunction (constantMap l E L (j.comp i) W)))).hom.app
          ((scalarConstantRestriction l E W).obj K)) ≫
        (scalarCompletion l E L (j.comp i) W).hom.app K
